query: Snag first: the last jacket I ordered looked nothing like its photo once I unfolded it, and the return postage ate my grocery money. This time it's a military-style bomber, and I'll wear it over whatever's clean (my roommate says my closet is a trail with no markers). Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. What the cloth itself looks like up close is where I get skeptical, fair or not. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Bomber jackets are the trail I'm on, and the style should be military (I'll look it over myself, don't you worry). And it ought to be something y'all actually have sitting on a shelf, not just a listing floating around on some website somewhere. Nothing over 1900 cts, y'all (every penny counts, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Past that number the climb gets too steep for me.

rules: Send at most 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 moves or tool calls.
If nothing fits, say so; do not offer substitutes.
Only buy items that are on the shelf in stock.
wishes: The cloth should look good up close.
